shots.title: Three grids, the every-grid overview: the rims back in cream

crops.label: grid 1 top-left card: outline stays dark, a 1 px cream sliver outside it

shots.seen: Three 5x5 grids side by side with a small even gap; grid 1 has its top row placed (6 of Knives, 4 of Balls, 8 of Balls, 3 of Hoops, Ace of Fires) and the five Entrance cards sit under grid 1. The grid 1 top-left card (the one the pink sliver sat on in round 1) keeps its own dark brown outline; cream shows only as a 1 px sliver outside that outline (this run: down part of its left edge; the previous run: along its top and lower-left edges). Compare the Entrance card in entrance_focus_rim, whose whole outer outline turns cream. I cannot tell from a still whether this card holds the keyboard focus; if it does, an occupied cell's focus rim is almost entirely hidden under the placed card.

shots.title: Three grids, the middle grid focused
shots.seen: The middle grid of three centred alone, 25 empty-cell marks (dashed red/yellow frames with their ranks and suits), no neighbours in view and no Entrance (it belongs to grid 1). No rim on any cell. Same as the round-1 approval.

shots.title: One grid, focused
shots.seen: One grid centred, its top row of five placed cards, four rows of marks, the five Entrance cards centred under it with columns aligned, the row label 1 left of the top row. The top-left placed card (6 of Knives) shows the same 1 px cream sliver outside its dark outline as in grid3_overview, not a full cream rim.

crops.label: top-left placed card: 1 px cream sliver outside a dark outline

shots.title: The whole window as a show opens
shots.seen: A show opening, caught mid-deal: the 5x5 marks, several still tilted as they fly in, five Entrance cards along the bottom (the rightmost face-down with a star back), the sidebar at left with Back/Forward/Wall above the HUD. The top-left cell wears a cream rim. Same shot as round 1.

shots.title: A lifted card described while the focus is elsewhere: no Deck button on a game card description
shots.seen: Jack of Fires lifted out of the Entrance (raised, a red strip under its slot); the keyboard focus on the bottom-left grid cell (an empty Queen of Hoops mark), which wears a cream rim. The sidebar describes that cell - title Queen of Hoops, then Hoop with its effect, then Grid Cell - with an X at top right and NO Deck button under the title.

crops.label: sidebar: no Deck row under the title
lifted Jack of Fires and the focused cell

shots.title: A focused Entrance card: the focus rim back in cream
shots.seen: Jack of Fires, the leftmost Entrance card, hovered/focused: its whole outer outline is cream (2 px), against the dark brown outline of the King of Hoops beside it; it sits a few px higher than its neighbours. The sidebar describes it (Jack of Fires, Fire and its effect) with no X and no Deck button.

crops.label: focused Jack of Fires: cream outline vs the dark one beside it

shots.title: The pack chooser up: Back, Forward and Wall greyed until Take
shots.seen: The pack chooser covers the whole map picture (opaque dark), five offered cards with Reroll under each, Rerolls: 5 top right, Take greyed at the bottom. The first card (5 of Knives) is stuck: cream rim, described in the sidebar with an X and the chooser's Deck button under the title. Back, Forward and Wall are all greyed.

crops.label: Back / Forward / Wall greyed while the chooser holds the player

shots.title: The map at its default fit beside the sidebar, with the sea buffer
shots.seen: The whole map at the fit beside the sidebar: land from about y=40 to y=660, sea-blue on every side of it, no grey and no wall anywhere; the token (yellow diamond) at the top with a highlighted yellow route. The sidebar shows the map HUD (Fame 0, Lap 1, Luck 0%, Deck). Because the map is square and the space beside the sidebar is wide, most of the buffer is sea left and right of the land.

crops.label: top edge: sea buffer above the land

shots.title: The map zoomed in by the wheel and dragged to its east edge
shots.seen: Zoomed in (2.76x against the 1.19 fit) and dragged against the map's top and right edges: land in the middle, sea to the right and above out to the window edge, no grey and no wall. On the left the map runs on under the sidebar - a small island is cut by the sidebar's edge at x=320. The sidebar shows the HUD. The wheel zooms about the token, not the pointer.

crops.label: right edge: sea to the window edge, no grey
left: map continues under the sidebar

shots.title: The first frame after Travel: back at the fit while the token walks
shots.seen: The first frame after Travel from the zoomed view: back at the fit (zoom 1.19), the whole map with sea round it, no grey; the token at the top of the map, just leaving its node. The sidebar shows the HUD, no description.

shots.title: The run deck open over the chooser; the chooser's Deck button stays up to close it
shots.seen: The run deck open over the chooser: a scrolling grid of the deck's cards on a dark panel, Rerolls: 5 and a greyed Take still visible, Back/Forward/Wall greyed. The sidebar keeps the stuck 5 of Knives with NO X, and the chooser's Deck button is visible under its title. Between the deck's second and third rows (y about 300-345) pieces of the chooser's own cards show through, and faint Reroll text near y=440 - the deck panel does not fully cover the chooser.

crops.label: chooser cards showing through the deck's row gap
sidebar: stuck card, no X, Deck visible

shots.title: A hovered run-deck card over the chooser: its description carries the Deck row - your ruling
shots.seen: As deck_over_chooser, with the pointer on the deck's Queen of Knives: the sidebar now describes Queen of Knives (Knife and its effect) and the Deck row sits under its title - a run-deck card's description over the chooser carries Deck. YOUR RULING: keep it (the row stays up while the chooser's deck is open) or hide Deck on a deck card's description. The same chooser cards show through the deck's row gap as in deck_over_chooser.
